title: Dean J Possible NDE 9839
content: After taking drugs, I went to sleep. I was walking down a path and clouds covered the sky. I came to a large, brick building which looked eerie. There was a large, iron fence in front of it with a large iron archway. A dirt road led up the the archway. The scene had a Halloween feel with leaves on the ground and a feeling of autumn. Suddenly, I was tumbling violently as if I was in a dryer with no heat. There was a piercing, ringing noise as I stumbled faster and faster until I woke back up. My body was sitting upright, soaked in water and on the ground. There were people holding me upright, rubbing my back, and asking me if I knew who or where I was. It took me a second to be able to respond. I felt as if I was barely back into my body and was still tethering back for a couple minutes. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 01/2022 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Drug or medication overdose. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) I overdosed and was found by my roommate. I was not breathing, given narcans 3 times. CPR and other efforts were given before I came back to consciousness How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? No Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Same Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Same Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes As I was tumbling back to what I can is my earth bound body. I saw only light and heard loud ringing Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place. I entered what was like an old asylum/cemetery with a massive, brick building, an iron gate and fence in a dark, cloudy setting which was quite eerie. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Was surely going to hell or a place like it Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. Came to an iron gate. I had no choice in my return; I just got sent tumbling back God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated. Did not believe in afterlife or a god Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I believe in a higher power What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Agnostic Believe in a god, Christianity but crossed with Judaism Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I did not believe in the afterlife and now I do Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes. Now I believe in a creator Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes. I'm pretty sure there is a hell and that's where I'm going During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. I attempted suicide multiple times and now I'm scared to die Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? I'm more honest After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I remember it vividly Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I no longer want to kill myself Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Not immediately though Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes. A book I read What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. It was definitely purgatory, a stage of limbo, or a waiting room for hell What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. Same At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? All good p50x8jc_nde

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Tumbling violently as if in a dryer; piercing ringing noise; stumbled faster and faster until waking.

environment.environment_other_detail: Large brick building (like an old asylum/cemetery); large iron fence and archway; dirt road to archway; dark cloudy setting; leaves on the ground; Halloween/autumn feel; eerie.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Sent tumbling back against his will, with loud ringing and seeing only light, until waking back up in his body.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drug or medication overdose; found not breathing; given Narcan three times; CPR and other efforts before returning to consciousness.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Prior: religious unaffiliated/agnostic, did not believe in afterlife or God. Now: unaffiliated agnostic; believes in God; 'Christianity but crossed with Judaism.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Dreamlike walking down a path to an eerie brick building with an iron fence/archway; then violent tumbling with ringing; woke in body being held up by others.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Entered an eerie environment first, then experienced tumbling/ringing and saw only light as he returned; no tunnel reported.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience began as walking down a path under cloudy skies toward an eerie brick building and iron gate with a Halloween/autumn feel; then sudden violent tumbling 'as if I was in a dryer' with piercing ringing.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Suddenly, I was tumbling violently as if I was in a dryer with no heat.”; “It was definitely purgatory, a stage of limbo, or a waiting room for hell.”; “I felt as if I was barely back into my body and was still tethering back for a couple minutes.”
